protocol.genome: 90 neural parameters plus three linked body traits. Every founder has speed60, radius8, range160. All traits inherit from the same parent as the brain.
protocol.mutation: Brain .1 probability and .1 Gaussian additive noise. Body .25 probability per allele and .08 Gaussian log noise; clip to bounds, round radius. Independent RNG streams; actual changed alleles recorded.
protocol.matched_scenarios: All treatments share maximum-radius anchors, heading/color/lifespan draws, and initial food. Actual size, speed, vision, capacity, initial energy and costs differ intentionally. Shared-layout hashes exclude these treated physical traits.
protocol.primary: Four fitness contrasts: joint minus founder and joint minus same evolved brain/reference body, separately in standard and scarce tests; exact two-sided paired sign tests, Holm over four.
protocol.decision: Adjusted p < .05 and paired mean-difference interval excluding zero in the same direction; ties <=1e-10. Independent source seed is unit, n=len(seeds).
protocol.secondary: Meals, survival, speed, energy costs, useful food energy, visibility, trait trends and brain/body interaction are descriptive without confirmatory p-values.
protocol.limitations: Stylized 2D energetics, not calibrated biology. All bodies receive the same100-unit birth budget, pay10*area development, then capacity clips initial reserves. No reproductive resource accounting or continuous growth. Cruise speed is genetically fixed within life, with neural throttle ignored. Lifespan and colors are not inherited. Fitness still rewards meals including partially wasted ones; energy assimilation and waste are reported. The reference-body brain condition is a frozen intervention, not a separately trained brain-only population. No static-body training or drift control, no global biological optimum claim.
